name: operator==,!=(std::geometric_distribution)

declarations.code:
friend bool operator==(const geometric_distribution &lhs,

    const geometric_distribution &rhs);

friend bool operator!=(const geometric_distribution &lhs,

    const geometric_distribution &rhs);

intro:
Compares two distribution objects. Two distribution objects are equal when parameter values and internal state is the same.

1) Compares two distribution objects for equality.

2) Compares two distribution objects for inequality.

These functions are not visible to ordinary unqualified or qualified lookup, and can only be found by argument-dependent lookup when std::geometric_distribution<ResultType> is an associated class of the arguments.

The != operator is synthesized from operator==.


(since C++20)

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

  distribution objects to compare

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1) true if the distribution objects are equal, false otherwise.

2) true if the distribution objects are not equal, false otherwise.
